subject: History
name: Basic 3 History
description: The Basic 3 History curriculum focuses on the origins of major ethnic groups in Ghana, inter-group relations, major historical locations, significant Ghanaian entrepreneurs, and the arrival of Europeans.

strands.title: My Country Ghana
strands.description: Exploring the origins of ethnic groups, inter-group relations, historical locations, and significant individuals.

subStrands.title: The People of Ghana
subStrands.description: Understanding the origins of major ethnic groups.

contentStandards.description: Exhibit knowledge of the unique history of the major ethnic groups in Ghana

indicators.description: Discuss the origins of the major ethnic groups in Ghana

exemplars.description: Identify some of the major ethnic groups. Eg. Guan, Mole-Dagbani/ Gonja, Akan, Ga/Adangme, Ewe
Use a map to trace the routes the major ethnic groups travelled to get to their present-day locations in Ghana
In groups, learners discuss the origin of the major ethnic groups
Compose a song with names of the major ethnic groups and where they originated (In the special schools, resource persons should assist the hearing impaired to sing)
Draw a map to locate the migratory routes of the ethnic groups. (this can also be done on a manila card)
Develop a timeline of the periods each ethnic group arrived in Ghana

subStrands.title: Inter-Group Relations
subStrands.description: Understanding exchanges, conflicts, and alliances among ethnic groups.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of how intergroup alliances, conflicts and other exchanges

indicators.description: Discuss the nature of exchanges among the ethnic groups

exemplars.description: Identify the forms of exchanges including forms of trade, inter-marriage, conflict and alliances
Discuss the benefit of these exchanges

indicators.description: Name some of the items exchanged among the various groups

exemplars.description: Identify trade items that were exchanged among ethnic groups: salt. fish, gold, kola, Shea butter, pottery and cloth and iron utensils
Match items with the areas / sources where the items were obtained. e.g. Shea butter - savannah belt
Explain the medium of exchange
Trace the origin of the name 'cedi'

indicators.description: Describe the conflicts and alliances that existed among the ethnic groups in Ghana

exemplars.description: Discuss intergroup wars such as Battle of Feyiase and the Krepi war of 1833

Discuss instances where alliances were formed between different groups to fight a common enemy. E.g. The Battle of Akatamanso where the Asante army was defeated by an alliance made up of the British, Ga, Fante, Akyem, Akwamu, Krepi and Denkyira Anlo / Asante in the Ada War of 1869

subStrands.title: Major Historical Locations
subStrands.description: Understanding forts and castles in Ghana.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of the forts and castle built in Ghana

indicators.description: Identify the forts and castles built along the coast of Ghana

exemplars.description: Explain the differences between forts and castles
With the use of internet, identify the major forts and castles on Ghana's coast on a map (where they are located, which Europeans built them and when and why they were built)
Explain some of the uses to which these forts and castles have been put since they were built. E.g. Seat of government, trading and education
Discuss the use to which these forts and castles were put since Ghana gained independence
Match these forts and castles with where they can be located
Learners draw their favourite castle
Show and discuss a documentary/ slides on forts and castles in Ghana
Visit any of these facilities to model any fort and castle

contentStandards.description: Describe the contributions of some outstanding Ghanaian entrepreneurs

indicators.description: Describe Ghanaian entrepreneurs who have made significant contributions

exemplars.description: Name Ghanaian entrepreneurs of note e.g. George Grant - Businessman, Winifred Tete-Ansa, Esther Ocloo - Nkulenu Industries, B.A. Mensah - Pioneer Tobacco Ltd. Kwabena Pepra - Paramount Distilleries, J.K. Siaw - Tata Brewery, Alhaji Adam Iddrisu - Global Haulage
Show pictures of some outstanding entrepreneurs in Ghana
Retell the live stories of any of these entrepreneurs from a documentary show
Identify the entrepreneurs who work inspires you most and give reasons for your choice

strands.title: Europeans in Ghana
strands.description: Understanding the arrival and settlement of Europeans.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of the interactions between the local people and early settlers

indicators.description: Describe how the Europeans settled on the Gold Coast, including forming alliances with the local chiefs

exemplars.description: Dramatise the meeting between the Portuguese and Kwamina Ansah
Explain why other Europeans who came later also settled on the Gold Coast
Investigate how the Europeans settled on the Gold Coast including forming alliances with the local chiefs and marrying the local people
